name: Frontliners' Run 2027
short_description: Frontliners' Run 2027 is on Sunday 31 January 2027 at Clark Parade Grounds in Clark, Pampanga, with 21 km, 10 km, 5 km and 3 km races from Smoke 10 Events Management.
ai_summary: Frontliners' Run 2027 takes place on Sunday 31 January 2027 at Clark Parade Grounds in Clark, Pampanga, with the event start listed at 3:00 am. It has 21 km, 10 km, 5 km and 3 km categories priced from PHP 999 to PHP 1,999. The organiser is Smoke 10 Events Management, and 21 km finishers receive a medal, finisher shirt and towel.

faqs.question: When is Frontliners' Run 2027?
faqs.answer: The race is on Sunday 31 January 2027, with the event start listed for 3:00 am Philippine time on the MyRunTime entry page. Online registration for all four categories closes on 25 January 2027. Separate gun times for each distance and cut-off times have not been posted yet.

faqs.question: What distances and prices are there?
faqs.answer: Four distances are offered: 21 km at PHP 1,999, 10 km at PHP 1,499, 5 km at PHP 1,199 and 3 km at PHP 999. The 21 km package includes a race singlet, bib, medal, finisher shirt and towel. Prices exclude MyRunTime's web admin and delivery fees.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: Start and finish are at Clark Parade Grounds inside Clark Freeport Zone, Pampanga, about 80 km north of Manila and near Clark International Airport. The wide, low-traffic roads of the freeport make Clark a regular venue for road races in Central Luzon.
